source: 本批真实数据CT/label逐类叠加核验：case0001、case0008测试体积；case0005、case0009共10张训练切片；证据见outputs/audit/organ_mapping_20261022T014306Z与.codex/synapse_label_mapping.md。标签语义通过抽样实物核对，原始预处理脚本来源未核实。
verified_by: Codex visual inspection of actual CT/label overlays
verification_scope: sampled semantic identity cross-check; not original preprocessing provenance
dataset: Synapse TransUNet preprocessed files in this workspace

classes.name: Aorta
classes.description: Aorta: The main trunk of the systemic arterial system, located in front of the spine.
classes.observation: 椎体前方的增强血管横断面，跨多个头尾层面连续出现。

classes.name: Gallbladder
classes.description: Gallbladder: A small pear-shaped organ beneath the right lobe of the liver.
classes.observation: 肝脏下方的胆囊轮廓；case0001较扁长，case0008较清晰。

classes.name: Left Kidney
classes.description: Left Kidney: A bean-shaped retroperitoneal organ on the left side of the spine.
classes.observation: 图像右侧、肝脏对侧的肾轮廓，与左侧脾脏的同侧关系一致。

classes.name: Right Kidney
classes.description: Right Kidney: A bean-shaped retroperitoneal organ on the right side of the spine.
classes.observation: 图像左侧、与肝脏同侧的肾轮廓，区别于label3。

classes.name: Liver
classes.description: Liver: The largest solid organ in the upper right quadrant of the abdomen.
classes.observation: 右上腹最大实质器官，轮廓跨左右叶。

classes.name: Pancreas
classes.description: Pancreas: An elongated organ located horizontally behind the stomach.
classes.observation: 位于胃后方、横行跨中线的胰腺实质轮廓。

classes.name: Spleen
classes.description: Spleen: An organ in the upper far left quadrant, to the left of the stomach.
classes.observation: 左上腹、胃外侧的脾实质；case0009训练图也清楚支持此对应。

classes.name: Stomach
classes.description: Stomach: A muscular hollow organ located in the upper abdomen.
classes.observation: 上腹部胃腔及胃壁；case0001内有明显高密度口服对比剂。
